027/**
028 * One tab of a tabbed {@link RowDetail}: a fields grid, a nested table, a chart or a client-rendered pane.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * The tab is loaded lazily: its content is fetched the first time the user opens it.  A tab id is the slug of its
032 * title unless {@link #id(String)} is given.
033 *
034 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
035 * <p class='bjava'>
036 *    RowDetail.<jsm>inline</jsm>()
037 *       .tab(DetailTab.<jsm>fields</jsm>(<js>"Details"</js>, <js>"id"</js>, <js>"name"</js>, <js>"price"</js>).columns(3))
038 *       .tab(DetailTab.<jsm>client</jsm>(<js>"Labels"</js>, <js>"pet-labels"</js>).endpoint(<js>"/pets/{id}/labels"</js>));
039 * </p>
040 *
041 * @since 10.0.0
042 */
043public final class DetailTab implements Handled<DetailTab> {
044
045   /** The tab kinds. */
046   public enum Kind {
047
048      /** A label/value grid of row fields. */
049      FIELDS("fields"),
050
051      /** A nested table scoped to the parent row. */
052      TABLE("table"),
053
054      /** A chart fed by an endpoint. */
055      CHART("chart"),
056
057      /** A pane drawn by a client-side renderer. */
058      CLIENT("client");
059
060      private final String wire;
061
062      Kind(String wire) {
063         this.wire = wire;
064      }
065
066      /**
067       * Returns the wire token.
068       *
069       * @return The lower-case token.
070       */
071      public String wire() {
072         return wire;
073      }
074   }
075
076   /** How a row detail caches the content of its tabs. */
077   public enum Cache {
078
079      /** A tab is fetched once per expanded row (the default). */
080      PER_ROW("per-row"),
081
082      /** A tab is fetched again each time it is activated. */
083      NONE("none");
084
085      private final String wire;
086
087      Cache(String wire) {
088         this.wire = wire;
089      }
090
091      /**
092       * Returns the wire token.
093       *
094       * @return The token.
095       */
096      public String wire() {
097         return wire;
098      }
099   }
100
101   private static final Pattern ID = Pattern.compile("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}");
102   private static final Pattern RENDERER = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}");
103
104   private record Group(String title, List<String> fields) {}
105
106   private final Kind kind;
107   private final String title;
108   private String id;
109   private String icon;
110   private String endpoint;
111   private String emptyText;
112   private String scopeParam = "parentId";
113   private String renderer;
114   private int columns;
115   private boolean refreshOnPoll;
116   private boolean countFromRows;
117   private boolean autoFields;
118   private final List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>();
119   private final List<Group> groups = new ArrayList<>();
120   private TableSpec view;
121   private RegionDef region;
122   private Function<String,Integer> counter;
123   private List<VisibilityRule> visibleWhen;
124   private final ModelBlock model;
125
126   private DetailTab(Kind kind, String title) {
127      if (ib(title))
128         throw iaex("DetailTab title must not be null or blank.");
129      this.kind = kind;
130      this.title = title;
131      this.model = new ModelBlock("detailtab", title);
132   }
133
134   @Override /* Handled */
135   public ModelBlock modelBlock() { return model; }
136
137   @Override /* Handled */
138   public DetailTab self() { return this; }

140   /**
141    * Starts a fields-grid tab.
142    *
143    * @param title The tab title.  Must not be blank.
144    * @param fields The row field names shown, in order.  Unique within the tab.
145    * @return A new tab.
146    */
147   public static DetailTab fields(String title, String...fields) {
148      var t = new DetailTab(Kind.FIELDS, title);
149      t.fields.addAll(Arrays.asList(fields));
150      return t;
151   }
152
153   /** Starts the generated Details tab whose field list the owning table fills in. */
154   static DetailTab autoFields(String title, List<String> fields) {
155      var t = new DetailTab(Kind.FIELDS, title);
156      t.autoFields = true;
157      t.fields.addAll(fields);
158      return t;
159   }
160
161   /**
162    * Starts a nested-table tab.
163    *
164    * @param title The tab title.  Must not be blank.
165    * @param view The nested table; it must declare a rows data URL.
166    * @return A new tab.
167    */
168   public static DetailTab table(String title, TableSpec view) {
169      var t = new DetailTab(Kind.TABLE, title);
170      t.view = view;
171      return t;
172   }
173
174   /**
175    * Starts a chart tab.
176    *
177    * @param title The tab title.  Must not be blank.
178    * @param region The chart region.
179    * @return A new tab.
180    */
181   public static DetailTab chart(String title, RegionDef region) {
182      var t = new DetailTab(Kind.CHART, title);
183      t.region = region;
184      return t;
185   }
186
187   /**
188    * Starts a client-rendered tab.
189    *
190    * @param title The tab title.  Must not be blank.
191    * @param renderer The name of a renderer registered in the browser; letters, digits, {@code . _ -}, at most 64.
192    * @return A new tab.
193    */
194   public static DetailTab client(String title, String renderer) {
195      var t = new DetailTab(Kind.CLIENT, title);
196      t.renderer = renderer;
197      return t;
198   }

200   /**
201    * Sets the tab id (default: the slug of the title).
202    *
203    * @param value The id; lower-case letter first, then lower-case letters, digits and {@code -}, at most 32.
204    * @return This object.
205    */
206   public DetailTab id(String value) {
207      id = value;
208      return this;
209   }

211   /**
212    * Sets the tab icon.
213    *
214    * @param value An icon name.
215    * @return This object.
216    */
217   public DetailTab icon(String value) {
218      icon = value;
219      return this;
220   }
221
222   /**
223    * Sets the per-tab GET endpoint.
224    *
225    * @param value A same-origin path template; {@code {id}} is replaced by the row id.
226    * @return This object.
227    */
228   public DetailTab endpoint(String value) {
229      endpoint = value;
230      return this;
231   }

233   /**
234    * Sets the text shown when the tab has nothing to show.
235    *
236    * @param value The text.
237    * @return This object.
238    */
239   public DetailTab emptyText(String value) {
240      emptyText = value;
241      return this;
242   }
243
244   /**
245    * Sets the grid column count of a fields tab.
246    *
247    * @param n The count, 1 to 4; 0 inherits the detail's count.
248    * @return This object.
249    */
250   public DetailTab columns(int n) {
251      columns = n;
252      return this;
253   }

255   /**
256    * Groups some of a fields tab's fields under a heading.  Fields in no group follow, under no heading.
257    *
258    * @param groupTitle The heading.
259    * @param groupFields The fields; each must be in the tab's field list and in no other group.
260    * @return This object.
261    */
262   public DetailTab group(String groupTitle, String...groupFields) {
263      groups.add(new Group(groupTitle, List.of(groupFields)));
264      return this;
265   }

267   /**
268    * Sets the query parameter carrying the parent row id to a nested table.
269    *
270    * @param value The parameter name (default {@code parentId}).
271    * @return This object.
272    */
273   public DetailTab scopeParam(String value) {
274      scopeParam = value;
275      return this;
276   }

278   /**
279    * Shows the nested table's row count in the tab label once the tab has loaded.  Table tabs only.
280    *
281    * @return This object.
282    */
283   public DetailTab countFromRows() {
284      countFromRows = true;
285      return this;
286   }

288   /**
289    * Sets a server-side counter shown in the tab label.  The value travels in the detail's {@code counts}.
290    *
291    * @param f Maps a row id to a count.
292    * @return This object.
293    */
294   public DetailTab count(Function<String,Integer> f) {

296      return this;

299   /**
300    * Sets whether the tab reloads when the table polls.
301    *
302    * @param value The flag (default <jk>false</jk>).

305   public DetailTab refreshOnPoll(boolean value) {

310   /**
311    * Hides the tab unless every rule matches.  Presentation only; it never authorises.
312    *
313    * @param rules The rules.
314    * @return This object.
315    */
316   public DetailTab visibleWhen(VisibilityRule...rules) {
317      visibleWhen = l(rules);
318      return this;
319   }
320
321   String resolvedId() {
322      return id != null ? id : slug(title);
323   }
324
325   static String slug(String t) {
326      return t.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-").replaceAll("^-+|-+$", "");
327   }
328
329   Kind kind() {
330      return kind;
331   }
332
333   boolean hasCounter() {
334      return counter != null;
335   }
336
337   Integer count(String rowId) {
338      return counter == null ? null : counter.apply(rowId);
339   }
340
341   List<String> fieldNames() {
342      return List.copyOf(fields);
343   }
344
345   private void validate() {
346      var rid = resolvedId();
347      if (! ID.matcher(rid).matches())
348         throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' id '%s' must match %s.", title, rid, ID.pattern());
349      if (endpoint != null && ! RegionDef.isSafeDetailEndpoint(endpoint))
350         throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' endpoint '%s' is not a same-origin path.", rid, endpoint);
351      if (countFromRows && kind != Kind.TABLE)
352         throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' countFromRows applies to table tabs only.", rid);
353      switch (kind) {
354         case FIELDS -> validateFields(rid);
355         case TABLE -> {
356            if (view == null)
357               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' needs a nested table.", rid);
358            if (ib(scopeParam))
359               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' scopeParam must not be blank.", rid);
360         }
361         case CHART -> {
362            if (region == null)
363               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' needs a chart region.", rid);
364         }
365         case CLIENT -> {
366            if (renderer == null || ! RENDERER.matcher(renderer).matches())
367               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' renderer '%s' must match %s.", rid, renderer, RENDERER.pattern());
368         }
369      }
370   }
371
372   private void validateFields(String rid) {
373      if (columns != 0 && (columns < 1 || columns > 4))
374         throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' columns must be 1 to 4, was %s.", rid, columns);
375      if (fields.isEmpty() && ! autoFields)
376         throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' needs at least one field.", rid);
377      var seen = new HashSet<String>();
378      for (var f : fields)
379         if (ib(f) || ! seen.add(f))
380            throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' field '%s' is blank or repeated.", rid, f);
381      var grouped = new HashSet<String>();
382      for (var g : groups)
383         for (var f : g.fields()) {
384            if (! seen.contains(f))
385               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' group '%s' names field '%s' which is not in the tab.", rid, g.title(), f);
386            if (! grouped.add(f))
387               throw iaex("DetailTab '%s' field '%s' is in more than one group.", rid, f);
388         }
389   }
390
391   /**
392    * Serializes this tab to its wire shape.
393    *
394    * @return The tab map.
395    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the tab is invalid.
396    */
397   public Map<String,Object> toMap() {
398      validate();
399      var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
400      m.put("id", resolvedId());
401      m.put("kind", kind.wire());
402      m.put("title", title);
403      if (icon != null)
404         m.put("icon", icon);
405      if (kind == Kind.FIELDS) {
406         if (columns != 0)
407            m.put("columns", columns);
408         m.put("fields", List.copyOf(fields));
409         if (! groups.isEmpty()) {
410            var gl = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
411            for (var g : groups) {
412               var gm = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
413               gm.put("title", g.title());
414               gm.put("fields", g.fields());
415               gl.add(gm);
416            }
417            m.put("groups", gl);
418         }
419      }
420      if (kind == Kind.TABLE)
421         m.put("nested", NestedSlot.of(view, scopeParam));
422      if (countFromRows)
423         m.put("count", "rows");
424      if (emptyText != null)
425         m.put("emptyText", emptyText);
426      if (endpoint != null)
427         m.put("endpoint", endpoint);
428      if (renderer != null && kind == Kind.CLIENT)
429         m.put("renderer", renderer);
430      if (refreshOnPoll)
431         m.put("refreshOnPoll", true);
432      if (kind == Kind.CHART) {
433         var r = new LinkedHashMap<>(region.toContractMap());
434         r.remove("contractVersion");
435         m.put("region", r);
436      }
437      if (visibleWhen != null && ! visibleWhen.isEmpty())
438         m.put("visibleWhen", VisibilityRule.toMaps(visibleWhen));
439      model.validate();
440      var mm = model.toMap();
441      if (mm != null)
442         m.put("model", mm);
443      return m;
444   }
445}
